title: Question on the page "connectGeoSearch"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[connectGeoSearch](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectGeoSearch.html)".

Could you help me understand how to use the `refine` and `setMapMoveSinceLastRefine` functions to enable map-move refinement with a Leaflet implementation?

The example doesn't deal with this, and I wasn't able to understand how to use it from the test fixture or source code.

Thank you!
Chris
